_comment: Every listener the machine configuration opens off a control plane,
and how the integration tier confirms it is open. The cluster module
gives each component the argument with the value; the tier dials the
port, the component's own default, and where the endpoint serves
without a credential reads the metric. A listener declared and not
dialled is how etcd's metrics port sat unopened while the repository
said otherwise (#493): written once here, the two cannot disagree.
metric is empty where the endpoint authenticates, so reaching the port
is all the tier can check.
